description: Built a go-to-market sales strategy from the ground up focusing on OEM partners, sales agents, industry associations, academic institutions, national end user accounts, and independent cinemas.
Prepared sales presentations and product demos for entertainment industry executives.
Researched industry trends in cinema entertainment and provided feedback to product management to improve product positioning.

Created global sales plan per international market (33 total) to focus resources on new product introductions, first-of-their-kind lighting applications, accurate project forecasting, and sales analytics reviews (margin trends, currency fluctuations, and cost of non-quality).
Built specifier (lighting designer, architect) relationships and project sales funnel through one-on-one meetings, industry presentations, and trade show attendance.
Recommended pricing strategies to win business.
Managed credit approvals to release orders on prepay, credit, or letter of credit.
Produced general marketing materials including videos, presentations, brochures.
Researched and developed web conferencing system for worldwide customer training to improve communication and reduce travel costs.

education.institution: University of Minnesota, Carlson School of Management

matchmaking_summary: Scott Kachelek is a seasoned professional with over 15 years of experience in business development and sales, primarily focused on large commercial projects involving digital LED lighting, immersive cinema technologies, and commercial printing control systems. His key personal traits include being proactive, creative, outgoing, analytical, persistent, and culturally aware. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated success in cross-regional international projects, business process improvement, competitive analysis, public presentations, sales strategy development, and strong relationships with partners across different regions, including Spanish and Japanese speaking markets.
